summary_1line: Bhishma explains that true authority comes from protecting people and outlines the virtues required of priests and the moral foundations of sacrifice and penance.

image_candidates.scene_text: A lone protector stands with raised staff between terrified villagers and a band of robbers on a dusty road.
Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while Yudhishthira stands beside him listening intently amid gathered sages.
A sacrificial fire burns as a calm priest pours clarified butter into the flames while chanting Vedic hymns.
